svg.title: MiloBroker ? illustrative builder WhatsApp conversation
svg.desc: A static sample chat. ABC Builders describes completed 13-floor towers with more open space near the international airport, with 2 and 3 BHK units available. Two illustrative attachments show residential towers and a home interior. MiloBroker replies that the ad was successfully saved. No images are uploaded and no ad is actually saved; all content and composer symbols are display-only.
